# Lexical static Nat bindings

Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

Eight informed desired projects were saved before implementation with sixteen real parser observations. The unchanged first sources have sixteen after-checks. Three positive sources then gain public host entries in a separate snapshot; six observer calls lacking checker selection remain, followed by six correctly selected calls. Total: 44 actual observations, two source snapshots; no blind benchmark.

`validation.json` distinguishes the bounded tests, original observer/test failures and remaining #28/#63 work. Widths 0, 2 and 4 use native hierarchy validation and an independent exact identity expectation on unequal complex amplitudes with an external reference. Native acceptance and source-step consistency do not prove universal source preservation or confer a new guarantee. No generic QFT implementation is included.
